_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 34: 7-14 November 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord brings up the Olympics many times and he does not know what it is about, wonders whether it is the nations coming together or the opening ceremony, and says he is anticipating February the 3rd to figure out what is going on.
mentions.quote: I'm anticipating on February the 3rd to really figure out what is going on
mentions.falsify_match: Something notable around the Winter Olympics.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing. Worth noting the Milan Cortina opening ceremony is 6 February, not the 3rd.

mentions.claim_text: He says the timing of it being brought up matters because he saw it come around January, says he told them he saw this around the first of the year in the Christmas season and that they would start to really talk about it, and points at the present as the confirmation.
mentions.quote: I said I saw this around the first of the year, Christmas season
mentions.falsify_match: A prior video in this corpus saying it, which is checkable here.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such prior statement. The subject is not named in this passage, which makes the recall hard to test.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts someone warning the nation about a period of ninety days, is corrected to forty and settles back on ninety, and says ninety days was the same timeframe the Lord gave him going all the way into the 4th of July.
mentions.quote: the same time frame the Lord said going into the 4th of July
mentions.falsify_match: A crisis running from now into 4 July.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The ninety days and the July date do not actually line up, and the confusion over the number is in the passage itself.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw something going into Honolulu with three men, specifically three, and notes that others in the ministry do the research rather than him.
mentions.quote: into Honolulu with three men. And I saw three men specifically
mentions.falsify_match: An incident in Honolulu involving three men.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The number is specific but the act is not stated.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him this will run all the way through 2026, 2027 and 2028, that they must pray for the judges and not just the well known ones, and that they will really try to come against Trump and the decisions he makes.
mentions.quote: this will be all the way through 2026 and 2027 and 2028
mentions.falsify_match: Sustained judicial conflict with the administration through 2028.
mentions.falsify_miss: It subsides. Three years of litigation against any administration is close to a certainty.

mentions.claim_text: He describes an infection with the Lord saying scandal, and a strategic knife cutting it to let the drainage out, and says that because of what the man was trying to do in running for president in 2028 he heard impeachment.
mentions.quote: I saw a strategic knife cutting it and letting the drainage out
mentions.falsify_match: A scandal deliberately surfaced against a 2028 candidate.
mentions.falsify_miss: None emerges. The man is not named in this passage.

mentions.claim_text: He says he would not put something that heavy on the internet in front of a hundred and fifty thousand to a million people when the man has family, is thankful he did not, and says he did not name the pastors he saw, citing 2 Corinthians.
mentions.quote: I didn't say who the pastors were that I saw
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is the recurring reason material stays unpublished: the unnamed subject cannot be checked.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says the money, fame and platform were all given by God for his glory but most took it as their own and made their own name great, and that the Lord told him to whom much is given much is required.
mentions.quote: to much is given, much is required
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a moral principle.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says of the megachurch sermon model that the Lord told him those days are done, repeated twice, and that they will see the manifestation of it even more in 2026.
mentions.quote: Those days are done. You'll see the manifestation of it even more in 2026
mentions.falsify_match: Megachurch closures or collapses reported through 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: Attendance holds. Manifestation is not defined.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying there will be a shaking in his church and in finances, and that the shakings will come like labour pains on a woman, back to back events happening all the time across finances and politics.
mentions.quote: they'll all happen like labor pains upon a woman
mentions.falsify_match: A run of closely spaced financial and church crises.
mentions.falsify_miss: A quiet stretch. Back to back events describe any news cycle.

mentions.claim_text: He works an example that borrowing a million dollars on a California house at around seven percent over fifty years means paying over five million, roughly three times what the house is worth in interest.
mentions.quote: you'll pay interest on for three times what that house is worth
mentions.falsify_match: Arithmetic, not prophecy, and the arithmetic is roughly right for a fifty year term.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: Asked whether the major crash is this year he says he does not believe it is this year, notes that many people think the economic crisis is coming, says the Lord told him he is giving a window, and states twice that this is his opinion.
mentions.quote: I don't believe it's this year. This is my opinion
mentions.falsify_match: No crash in the remainder of 2025, which is what happened.
mentions.falsify_miss: A crash before the end of 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a flash but does not know what year, and struggles to recall the name of the man who just won before someone supplies it, meaning the incoming New York mayor.
mentions.quote: But I saw a flash. What year? I don't know
mentions.falsify_match: An explosion or flash event connected to New York under the new mayor.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He states outright he does not know the year, and needed the name supplied to him.

mentions.claim_text: He leads declarations of freedom from cigarettes, alcohol and whatever else, on the principle of calling those things that be not as though they were, since whom the son sets free is free indeed.
mentions.quote: Calling those things that be not as though they were
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is the mechanism behind the declaration claims generally: the statement is treated as the accomplishment.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he keeps telling them about a major plague, another plague, but that it does not happen until November and December of a year, and that he keeps praying into 2027 and 2028 and January.
mentions.quote: it doesn't happen until November and December of a year
mentions.falsify_match: An epidemic starting in a November or December in that range.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Which year is left open, which is the loosening.

mentions.claim_text: He says you either know who you are and walk in the authority of the believer for what is coming or you will be eaten by the devourer, and that there is no more church as usual.
mentions.quote: THERE'S NO MORE CHURCH USUAL
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he keeps hearing that Venezuela will be like Iraq, that Russia will step in along with other nations and Kim, that they all have a plan and are holding their cards waiting for Trump to be done with his term, and that they want to overthrow.
mentions.quote: Venezuela will be like Iraq. That's what I keep hearing
mentions.time_phrase: waiting for Trump to be done
mentions.falsify_match: A prolonged American military entanglement in Venezuela with Russian involvement.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such entanglement.

mentions.claim_text: He says he hears black swan events and paid demonstrators, that on the budget in January he sees him fixing it soon and quickly, that they must pray for the tariffs and the judges, and that this is done and simply has not been announced yet.
mentions.quote: This is done. It's not been announced yet
mentions.falsify_match: A budget resolution announced in January 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: No resolution, or another shutdown. Saying a thing is already done and merely unannounced is the strongest form he uses.

mentions.claim_text: He says he has seen a lot tonight, that he is navigating through it and doing pretty well, then doubts that and says maybe he is not doing as well as he thinks but is trying, and calls it a great responsibility.
mentions.quote: Maybe I'm not doing as good as what I think I am, but I'm trying
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and unusually unguarded.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He prays over the people and the nation and thanks God for divine protection over President Trump, telling listeners they must pray over him.
mentions.quote: We thank you for divine protection over President Trump
mentions.falsify_match: He survives, which is credited to the prayer.
mentions.falsify_miss: Structurally unfalsifiable: an attempt is the warning fulfilled, no attempt is the prayer working.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord has been talking a lot and it is all kept on their records, that he said 2026, and that he saw turbulence three times over alongside the blessing, acceleration and the church.
mentions.quote: he said 2026. And I saw turbulence, turbulence, turbulence
mentions.falsify_match: A turbulent 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: A calm one. Turbulence is not specified as financial, political or spiritual.

mentions.claim_text: He says to focus on the light because the glorious church is going to rise, but that darkness will get darker and light will get lighter, a two-sided coin where things look like all hell is breaking loose.
mentions.quote: darkness get darker and light get lighter
mentions.falsify_match: Structurally unfalsifiable and worth naming as such: good news confirms the light, bad news confirms the darkness.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He reads a news item that the Senate voted 60 to 40 to back a revamped GOP funding bill keeping the government open until the end of January, with eight Democrats joining Republicans, and asks them to pray over those few.
mentions.quote: Pray over these few
mentions.falsify_match: n/a: a report of something that had already happened.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He describes seeing the plan: cut off the money, tell them their election is coming up next year and to do what they are told. He says he sees fires, and that if they can just get them to flip right there it will be over, adding that these people are not far from it.
mentions.quote: If we can just get them to flip right there, it will be over
mentions.falsify_match: Documented funding pressure on legislators ahead of the midterms.
mentions.falsify_miss: None documented. This describes ordinary party discipline in prophetic terms.

mentions.claim_text: He anticipates the objection that this sounds like science fiction or that he is on something, and answers that all he is doing is telling what he is seeing of what is coming in the future.
mentions.quote: all that seems so sci-fi, so out there
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as framing, though the video's subject, life extension through AI, is checkable in principle.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says trying to explain the supernatural is like trying to explain a hot sandy beach to an Eskimo who has no idea what it is like.
mentions.quote: trying to explain a hot sandy beach to an Eskimo
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it pre-emptively excuses vagueness in the descriptions that follow.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a
